character.description: The same young adult nonbinary herbalist anime protagonist in every shot: moss-brown curls beneath a soft hood, bright amber eyes, with a recognizable consistent face and adult body proportions. They are a mushroom forager who knows the secret paths beneath the old forest. Fixed costume: a moss-green hooded cape over a warm russet tunic, wool leggings, and sturdy boots. Signature tool or keepsake: a tiny lantern shaped like a spotted mushroom cap. Maintain the exact same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, proportions, costume silhouette, and signature object across the complete music video.
consistency_rules: One clearly defined protagonist leads this theme from beginning to end.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions in every scene.
Preserve the signature outfit, its color identity, and the defining tool or keepsake.
Do not redesign, replace, or multiply the lead character unless the lyrics explicitly require another person.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in ring of giant mushrooms, hollow in an old tree, mossy fallen log; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with toadstool red, moss green, glow teal, bark brown; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by ground-level tracking among giant caps, slow upward tilt along a glowing stalk, close-up of drifting spores; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
